policy: All overrides must have inventory entries. Every remaining entry was re-verified on 2026-11-24 against with/without-override resolutions (docs/dependency-override-second-pass.md); this inventory is still not a claim that each pin is permanent.

overrides.name: chrome-launcher
overrides.reason: Not a security pin (removal audits clean). Without it @lhci/cli 0.16.1 resolves its declared chrome-launcher ^0.13.4, which pulls rimraf@3; rimraf@3 expects the glob 7 callback API but the glob override forces glob 14.0.2 onto it. The override keeps @lhci/cli on chrome-launcher 1.x, but also holds lighthouse 13.6.0 at 1.2.1, below its declared ^1.2.2.
overrides.removalCriteria: Remove once @lhci/cli declares chrome-launcher >=1.2.2, or replace with a parent-scoped '@lhci/cli>chrome-launcher' rule so lighthouse resolves its own range; verify `lhci collect` in CI.

overrides.name: glob
overrides.reason: GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 affects glob 9 through 14.0.1; v14.0.2 fixes abort handling. Re-verified 2026-11-24: without the override the graph resolves vulnerable glob 13.0.7 (@jest/reporters, jest-config, jest-runtime, @sentry/bundler-plugins ask ^13.0.6) and 10.5.0 (rimraf 5 ^10.3.7, test-exclude 7 ^10.4.1). Note: the exact pin is below the ^14.0.3 that rimraf 6.1.4 declares.
overrides.removalCriteria: Remove once direct parents resolve glob >=14.0.2 without forced override and full CI passes.

overrides.name: minimatch@10
overrides.reason: GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 affects minimatch >=7.0.0 <11.0.1. Re-verified 2026-11-24: without the override, ^10.2.2 requests from @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.69-8.72, readdir-glob 3.0.0 and test-exclude 7.0.2 resolve vulnerable minimatch 10.2.6.
overrides.removalCriteria: Remove once all v10 requesting parents select patched 11.0.1 without an override and CI passes.
